verdict.rationale: Stripe documents meter events as records of customer actions used to bill on usage, built on the Billing Meters API within its usage-based billing models. This covers the core of sending usage events into a metering pipeline. The evidence says nothing about high-volume streaming throughput, idempotent ingestion, or backdated event timestamps. missing for 10: evidence of high-volume/streaming ingestion, idempotency keys or deduplication for meter events, backdating support, independent hands-on corroboration.
